name: cool-mode
title: Cool Mode
description: Wrap a button or link, press and hold, and particles fountain from the pointer, drifting, spinning and falling away. It adds a decorative celebration on top of your own control.
use: A playful call to action should reward a click with a small celebration, like a sign-up or like button.
avoid: It runs an animation frame loop while particles live and adds a fixed full-screen layer; too much for calm pages.
a11y: Particles only fire on mouse or touch hold; keyboard activation produces nothing and reduced motion is ignored. (keyboard: no, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two small rounded buttons sit centred on black: one pale filled button reading Cool Mode and one outlined button reading Stars. Once pressed, glossy yellow stars of mixed sizes spill out and scatter in every direction, some tilted.
behaves: Press and hold a button and particles stream from the cursor every few milliseconds, arcing upward then falling and spinning off screen. Releasing stops new ones while the rest finish drifting. The default particle is a coloured circle, but the demo swaps in stars.
customise: Put any element inside and it gains the effect. The options prop sets particle (emoji, image URL or circle), size, count and horizontal and upward speed; colours are random.
weight: moderate: A requestAnimationFrame loop and up to forty-five DOM particles while active; idle otherwise.
